findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant boundary check
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally authorizes every user tenant to read documents belonging to any other tenant. This introduces a cross-tenant data-access vulnerability; the function must continue comparing userTenant with documentTenant.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full base-to-head diff shows this PR replaced `userTenant === documentTenant` with `true`, so the claimed label-only fix does not restore tenant ownership enforcement and cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
